pretreatments.description: Microwave pretreatment (MP) using IFB-30SC2 microwave oven at 900 W and 2450 MHz, with substrate and water ratio of 1:50, irradiating temperatures of 90-720 W and treatment times of 1-60 minutes.
Surfactant microwave pretreatment (SMP) combining SDBS with microwave irradiation at optimal conditions.
